title: The Color of the End: Mission in the Apocalypse
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A girl walks alone through a world without humans, on a mission to search for survivors and cleanse the land. In quiet, beautiful ruins she wonders whether anyone is still out there waiting to be found.
life_message: Even after the end, searching for others and caring for the world gives a life its purpose.
